title: 26 February 2015: Ringo Starr live at HSBC Brasil, São Paulo, Brazil
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at HSBC Brasil in São Paulo, Brazil, on 26 February 2015.

It was the ninth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

Thank you Sao Paulo what a great night great show great great audience Love love peace and love ?????????xxxx

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) February 27, 2015

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
